reviews.text: The team were absolutely wonderful looking after Eddie my big maine coon.  After having a difficult time losing his brother, Emily was incredible in terms of engagement, doing thorough health investigations and just putting my mind at ease. After having extensive debtal treatment, he's got a new spring in his step which goes to show the importance of keepibg your pets healthy and regularly checked. The team even went out their way several times to bring him through the back as he can be very anxious going to the vets.  Highly recommend this wonderful practice!
Very friendl, professional and experienced staff.
Brilliant  staff

Regularly stop by for a coffee in Giffnock at Bark and Brew, the coffee shop within the Southside Veterinary Clinic. Everybody made welcome, great barista coffee and Matchas etc, and the lovely staff make this a great spot to relax, meet a friend or people watch. If you love animals then heaven. Highly recommend...
☕️
Recently registered our cat with the clinic recently and the staff could not have been more welcoming to us. They took such good care of him and kept us updated throughout his time with them.

I really can’t recommend Southside Vets. It looks great. It’s modern and it’s a nice place. But none of that really matters when you have a terrible experience. My husband signed us up after meeting the clinic manager in the park and our first experience was lovely. We came in with one of our dogs and got a great welcome, the manager even holding our coffees as we met the vet who was friendly and knowledgeable.

Fast forward a year and I am sorry to say we had a rather unpleasant experience while we waited for an appointment in the back waiting room. I overheard a conversation between two of the nursing staff which made me feel very uncomfortable, having to hear what was being said about the vet they had to work with. It was horrible.

It made me feel so uneasy that I really couldn’t go back and meet with the vet and so we will be moving our dog back to Rouken Glen.

A vets is meant to be a professional place where you can trust the vets and nurses. Southside vets is not that.

My mum came home to find my wee boy Bentley passed away in his sleep at on the sofa. I was devastated as he had shown no signs of any illness or anything.

I want to express my huge thanks and care you took when my mum when unfortunately i couldn’t take him to the practice as it was to much.

They said it could take upto 2 weeks to get his ashes back but within 10 days Bentley was back home where ge belongs.

Ive always highly recommended SVC for there care and treatment towards my pets and will continue to do so.

From myself and my family. Thank you for all you did. The locks of hair and paw prints was a lovely touch and something to keep of him in his keepsake box along with his ashes.

Thank You
Liam

I honestly cant thank this team enough for saving my cat Kyro

We rushed him in in a terrible state after he swallowed a bottle teat this has happened before but this time he deteriorated badly and even started having a seizure I ran in carrying him absolutely terrified

From the second I walked in the staff were incredible they took Kyro straight from my arms and acted immediately no hesitation their speed and professionalism saved his life

While I was waiting they didnt just focus on Kyro they looked after me too I was shaken and they kept me calm reassured me the whole time and even made me a hot chocolate with cream that meant everything in that moment

Kyro was at deaths door and they brought him back

Now nearly two weeks after surgery he is back to his normal self full of life and being his usual rascal again

I will be forever grateful absolutely amazing people

The dream team 🙏

I highly recommend this vets for anyone who is an animal lover …. You will have total peace of mind thanks to south side vets 👊👊
This was our first time with SVC and they were wonderful. Very friendly and helpful and our wee dog was so very well looked after. Highly recommended!
Took excellent care of my Spaniel. He required a major op and after care.

Their negligence and blasé attitude killed my dog.

I don't say this lightly and it's been several months now, but I want people who go here to understand that the staff here have displayed a lack of care on a medical level that in my opinion led to the preventable death of my dog.

I originally came to them for help with his teeth, which they operated to remove seven of. This to their credit, went over well despite his heart problems, however it became quite clear that he developed tremendous problems eating after that and I poceeded to come and seek help from them several times over the course of a half year.

Every time my concerns over his clearly apparent issues and symptoms were shrugged off, saying his vitals are normal, there's nothing wrong with him.

He died of a ruptured gall bladder after I had once more gone to see them and said the colour of his stool was concering, but did nothing and didn't even tell me to go to the hospital. Just gave him back to me and told me to keep an eye on him.

I had to rush him to the emergency vet that night when it got worse and when they finally got him under for surgery he just couldn't take the anaesthetic anymore.

They next day Southside vets called me about something and when I told the person he passed away, she that "oh, that's fine."

A word directly to southside vets: do not dare to contact me. Do not answer this review. I do not want to hear a word out of you. "That's fine" was plenty. I genuinely hope you go and find a different career.
What a great place! Really helpful and lovely staff.. went above and beyond to help us and pup out!

Very impressed with our first experience of SVC.
Kerry (nurse) and Carly (reception) showed such compassion and kindness when we brought our cat Elvis in.
Everything explained, time given.
Good customer service and quality care.
Thank you to all.

We took our wee babe here for consultation after he had fluid drained from his chest but he couldn’t be saved unfortunately and he was suffering so we made the tough decision to put him to sleep.
The euthanasia process was quick and painless.
We got to spend his last moments with him.
The vet was incredibly patient and understanding.
I appreciate all of the staff at Southside Vet Clinic for their compassion and kindness.
I would highly recommend them.
Thank you so much.

I am so pleased we registered with Southside Veterinary Clinic. My dog has complex behavioural needs and a deep fear of being handled by strangers, so vet visits have always been incredibly stressful for both of us. The care she receives here is exceptional.

Layla is patient, calm and completely in control of the environment. Yasmin is gentle and positive which is so reassuring. A special thanks to Rebekah who has taken the time to understand and settle my nerves. The whole team has made effort to build trust, and I am totally confident my dog is in safe and capable hands.
I cannot recommend Southside Veterinary clinic enough especially Paul, Kelly and Yasmin! Thank you so much for making sure Honey was ok and for going over and above! I really appreciate it.

Me and my pal visited this place by accident today, orignally going next door, but we noticed SVC have a wee coffee corner inside big cups, great price, brilliant ambience, unlimited pet snuggles, Really friendly staff, and again brilliant place!

Fantastic vets! All of the team, feom receptionist to the vets are fantastic and really friendly. I have a dog that can be quite nervous,  however the vet Layla is very patient with him and knows when he is getting a bit stressed. Would highly recommend this independent vets!

I recommend this vet to any animal lovers. My dog had to have an operation and the vet (Paul) and nurse stayed with my dog the whole night. On the Monday, they took the dog for a whole day so I could get some rest because I was not sleeping. This is the only vet I know who would do this for your animal and I would strongly recommend them.
Chose southside veterinary clinic as wanted to join an independent practice. The staff are all lovely and professional and have only had great experiences there with our dog.
Coffee shop in the vet clinic?! Also reasonably priced and very friendly vets

I visited this veterinary practice on the recommendation of a close friend. Initially, my impressions were positive: the location is convenient, the staff appeared experienced, and they were welcoming during my cat’s first consultation.
However, my experience took a negative turn when my cat sustained a leg injury. I brought him in for treatment, as he was limping and in evident pain. The practice estimated me around £460 for treatment. Upon completion, the final bill amounted to £521.
The following day, I was dismayed to find that my cat’s wound had reopened, with only a single stitch remaining (he initally had 8 stitches). I contacted the practice to report this issue and was informed that repairing the wound with staples would incur an additional charge of £58 plus sedation costs and staple removal. Though I was dissatisfied with the extra cost, I booked an appointment to ensure my pet’s wellbeing and said I will leave a bad review.
Later that day, I received a call from one of the company directors. Rather than addressing my concerns, he adopted a defensive tone, repeatedly asserting that their vet 'Is the best veterinary surgeon in Scotland,' boasting years of experience' and claiming that 'every vet in Scotland refers to her.' He appeared to take personal offense at the failure of the stitches, despite the professed expertise of the team.
He also mentioned that establishing his practice had cost him £1 million, a detail entirely irrelevant to my situation. Most troublingly, he advised he is cancelling my scheduled appointment and demanded on knowing where I intended to take my cat next, threatening to contact the new provider to warn them about me potentially posting a negative review.
I rarely take time to write negative reviews, but this unprofessional handling of this situation is extremely concerning. I have never in my 15 years of owning pets have experienced his level of arrogance and intimidation by a veterinary practice.

We're absolutely loving our new vets for our wee puppy Archie.
The staff are so friendly and already given us lots of tips and tricks for our pup as his breed is new to us, we had a siberian husky and from 1yr old previously so a golden retriever puppy is very new to us!
We can't wait for the puppy socialising classes next week.

Can’t praise highly enough . The practice has a lovely feel with coffee bar and relaxing which can only help anxious animals . Staff highly experienced , knowledgable and reassuring . My 12 week old pup had to have surgery and they were brilliant . Owners came and introduced themselves and really made you feel welcome and the care for the animals at forefront. Staff so friendly & welcoming . It feels like a family practice and genuine experience of not only great care but professionalism & knowledge in all they do. A very different approach to usual “clinical feel” vet practice but one I’d highly recommend .

I recently visited the clinic for a rabbit spay, it can be difficult to find an experienced and knowledgeable practice when it comes to rabbits but Layla and her team had my mind at ease every step of the way! Yasmin especially was so patient with me, she explained what the day would consist of when I first arrived with my rabbit and kept me updated with phone calls throughout the day which really helped settle my nerves. The full team were excellent throughout the recovery process and made it clear they were only ever a phone call away whenever I had any questions or needed some advice as a first time rabbit owner.
The reception staff are always welcoming upon arrival and are lovely to chat to whilst waiting, I can’t recommend this facility enough!! ⭐️✨

So happy to have found a proper experienced Vet on my doorstep.
Makes such a difference.
So grateful for all the staff at the Southside Vet Clinic. A kind/caring environment and very professional. Our kitten is so comfortable every-time we visit.

I can really recommend southside vets. From reception, to the nurses to the vet everyone was professional and kind and the premises are really clean and modern. My dog has had a persistent issue and the vet was compassionate and took the time to explain what the likely cause was as well as various treatment pathways to get her on mend. Thank you!!

I cannot praise this team enough all staff very helpfull and and friendly  we have not had any need for anything more
than boosters and nails clipped.Ŵinnie already feels at-home there and enjoys pup cups. Thank you everyone.

It took me a long time to put all of this into words, but even so, words cannot truly reflect the gratitude we feel towards these people. Thank you a hundred times over—we are full of admiration for the care you provided to our best friend. You took care of him as if Oscar were your best friend, and I believe he became just that from the moment you first met him. Our gratitude for what you did for our dog, Oscar, knows no bounds. Thank you so, so much—we love you dearly.

P.S. Words really cannot express the gratitude we feel. We wish you all the very best. Thank you!

Cannot recommend this practice highly enough. Wish they had opened sooner as they provided what can only be described as the most compassionate and caring end of life care for our beloved dog Boo. They made his last few weeks as comfortable …
Great service today. Staff are all lovely. So glad I found this place for my wee dog!

We recently took our Border Collie for a scale and polish procedure. From start to finish, the experience was extremely friendly and well-organized. We felt reassured knowing our dog was in safe hands. …

Switched to Southside vets a few months back as I prefer an independent vet. Couldn’t be more pleased with the care and attention given to my dog so far.  Would definitely recommend. All vets, nurses and staff seem to genuinely care about animals

Amazing vet. I can't recommend Southside Veterinary highly enough. My 12 year old cocker spaniel needed her teeth cleaned and some extractions which she has just come home after.  Everybody at the clinic was so friendly, helpful and …

First visit today with our 12 year old Husky. Just wanted to say thanks to the team who were very friendly, helpful and informative about everything. Layla head of services was excellent. We decided to go there after having a bad experience with another vet and I’m so happy we did. Would highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet.
What a pleasant experience both for myself and our 2 golden retrievers meeting all the staff at Southside Vets this morning. So delighted we have joined this new local independent vets.
